summary: Default-off async block-cache admission was implemented and exercised on A100 120000x8/gen_len=100/cache_ratio=0.05 with --use_cuda_graph. Correctness passed for opt013-capacity and the required lower-memory schedule, but opt013-capacity decode regressed to 195.417338 tok/s and the lower-memory schedule regressed to 192.108815 tok/s plus worse e2e latency, so no candidate satisfied the no-worse-throughput retention gate.
evidence: Raw logs and CSVs are under attempts/opt_attempt_016_async_cache_admission_overlap/raw/{opt013_capacity_async_admission_120k_b8_cr0p05,late25_tail_0p625_async_admission_120k_b8_cr0p05}; both logs contain RETROINFER_OUTPUT_JSON.all_outputs_contain_groundtruth=true and returncode 0. SOURCE_DIFF.patch sha256=d145567017f86bd7183d955d2f4f410ae1f4778bf80b0486b44f039ba494ce1a; frontier_check.raw.txt passed; ENV_AUDIT.raw.txt proves side_stream_cudagraph_replay=ok.
baseline_identity: Reused certified canonical baseline research/BASELINE_RESULT.json and validated opt013 research/VALIDATION_RESULT.json; no healthy baseline or Figure 13 rerun.
candidate_identity: Candidate source is repository HEAD 7096eab9190da389bbc75c1992140d1432d9d8ec plus SOURCE_DIFF.patch d145567017f86bd7183d955d2f4f410ae1f4778bf80b0486b44f039ba494ce1a, adding RETROINFER_ASYNC_CACHE_ADMISSION to cache_hub/retroinfer_cache.py and telemetry export in throughput_eval/reproduce_block_cache.py.
path_coverage: Both measured candidates set RETROINFER_ASYNC_CACHE_ADMISSION=1 and --use_cuda_graph; RETROINFER_RESULT_JSON reports async_cache_admission_enabled=true, async_cache_admission_uses_cuda_graph_update=true, async_cache_admission_launch_count=3168, async_cache_admission_sync_count=3168, pending_device_count=0, proving the changed side-stream admission path was exercised.

mechanism.default_behavior: Unset/empty/0 keeps inline default-stream admission; only explicit truthy values enable side-stream admission.
mechanism.enabled_behavior: After wave_buffer.sync() prepares update indices, gather_copy_and_scatter or the existing update CUDAGraph is launched on a per-device side stream. The current stream waits on the recorded event before the next execution-buffer write/cache read on that device.
mechanism.safety_invariant: The shared execution buffer must not be overwritten while a side-stream admission kernel still reads it; opt016 enqueues wait_event before gather_copy_and_concat or stream-only gather uses that buffer again. Later same-layer cache reads are also ordered by that wait.

source_rebuild_status.notes: No CUDA 12.4-compatible nvcc/CUDA_HOME was proven; /usr/bin/nvcc is CUDA 12.0 and /usr/local/cuda-13.3/bin/nvcc is CUDA 13.3.

candidates.description: Isolate opt013 capacity schedule with async block-cache admission enabled.
candidates.rejection_reason: Correctness passed and e2e latency improved in one round, but decode throughput was worse than opt013 and block-cache/peak memory were unchanged, so it is not a retained Pareto improvement.

candidates.description: Mission-specified lower-memory schedule with async block-cache admission enabled.
candidates.rejection_reason: Correctness passed and memory was lower, but decode and e2e generated throughput were worse than opt013, so the retention gate failed and no 2-round rerun was warranted.

bounded_stop_reason: The required opt013-capacity isolation showed a decode regression, and the required lower-memory schedule passed correctness but failed both decode and e2e throughput gates versus opt013. No candidate was retained, so no retained-candidate 2-round rerun or second lower-memory schedule was run.
validation_commands: side-stream CUDAGraph replay probe recorded in ENV_AUDIT.raw.txt
limitations: No profiler timeline was collected, so launch/sync telemetry proves code path execution but not actual GPU overlap.
The async admission mechanism is default-off and not retained for the measured A100 120000x8 point because it did not satisfy the throughput gate.
Source rebuild remains an environment/toolchain blocker, separate from the Python/runtime mechanism result.
